svg.aria-label: AI and machine learning for materials. Closed loop: a surrogate model ranks candidate materials, simulations or experiments evaluate the selected ones, and the results update the model Machine-learning interatomic potentials are trained on DFT data and drive molecular dynamics; a generative model then takes long time steps that plain MD covers in many femtosecond steps
svg.title: AI and machine learning for materials
svg.text: AI and machine learning for materials
a Closed-loop discovery with Bayesian optimization
b ML interatomic potentials and generative dynamics
